Name: Safe Lightning
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Safe Lightning[/size]
[size=3]
This mod stops lightning from hitting your fruit trees, normal trees, crops, flooring, etc. It stops lightning from hitting anything but lightning rods. The lightning visual and sound effects will still happen, but your farm will be fine :)[/size]

[u]For mod creators:[/u]
If you want your mod to create lightning (read: lightning that can damage terrain features), see this article for how to allow Safe Lightning protect users from your mod if it is also installed: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/34]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/34[/url]﻿.

[size=5][b]**In multiplayer, the host must have this mod installed for it to work. If other players have the mod installed, it won't do anything (but they can keep it installed with no problem)**[/b][/size]

Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild. To install, place the SafeLightning folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]
